semantic_deltas: An explicit aging-versus-control molecular comparison is an aging analytic role.

selection_rule: Select R+C only if all-tracked exact agreement is higher than T+C.
Reject R+C if decision-driving agreement or route agreement is lower than T+C.
Freeze the selected arm before opening the sealed holdout.
stop_rule: No further development-set prompt tuning after this cycle, regardless of outcome.
interpretation_constraint: The sealed holdout is the only confirmation set and cannot be reused for tuning.
